headline: Devki Group Plans Multi-Billion-Shilling Cement Plant in Nyeri
summary: Kenyan manufacturing firm Devki Group plans to build a multi-billion-shilling cement plant in Nyeri County, aimed at boosting local industrial production and employment.
why: Capital expenditure in heavy manufacturing and construction materials signals expectations of steady domestic infrastructure and real estate demand.

impacts.name: Construction & Building Materials
impacts.why: New multi-billion-shilling cement plant investment expands industrial capacity and regional supply.
